headlines.title: DoorDash Releases Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
headlines.summary: SAN FRANCISCO, October 29, 2026--DoorDash, Inc. (NASDAQ: DASH) today announced its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

headlines.title: DoorDash to Acquire Instacart to Help Local Stores Win
headlines.summary: SAN FRANCISCO, October 29, 2026--DoorDash, Inc. (NASDAQ: DASH) and Maplebear Inc. (d.b.a. Instacart, NASDAQ: CART) today announced a definitive agreement under which DoorDash will acquire Instacart for a total value of $65.00 for each Instacart share, or an equity value of approximately $17 billion.

headlines.title: DoorDash Moves Earnings Date Forward Amid Instacart Deal Reports
headlines.summary: DoorDash Inc., the food delivery provider in talks to take over Instacart, moved its earnings release date forward by almost a week.

headlines.title: DoorDash Announces Date and Time Change of Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Conference Call
headlines.summary: SAN FRANCISCO, October 29, 2026--DoorDash, Inc. (NASDAQ: DASH) announced today that it has changed the date and time of the release of its third quarter 2026 financial results and related earnings conference call. The company will now report its earnings for the third quarter 2026 on Thursday, October 29, 2026, prior to market open, and host a conference call at 5:30 a.m. PT / 8:30 a.m. ET the same day. headlines.title: Huge, Unusual Call Options Volume with DoorDash Ahead of Earnings - Is DASH Undervalued?
headlines.summary: DoorDash is showing unusually large volume in out-of-the-money call options today. This follows reports that DoorDash could be interested in buying Instacart (CART). Is DASH undervalued here?

description: DoorDash, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a commerce platform that connects merchants, consumers, and dashers in the United States and internationally. The company operates DoorDash Marketplace, Wolt Marketplace, and Deliveroo Marketplace, which provide various services, such as customer acquisition, demand generation, order fulfillment, merchandising, payment processing, and customer support. It also offers consumer membership programs, DashPass, Wolt+, and Deliveroo Plus; advertising as a value-added service through its marketplaces; and white-label delivery fulfillment services, as well as services that help merchants establish online ordering, build branded mobile apps, manage reservations and in-store dining, manage consumer relationships, enable tableside order and pay, and improve customer support. The company was formerly known as Palo Alto Delivery Inc. and changed its name to DoorDash, Inc. in 2015. DoorDash, Inc. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
